title: Prepare recovery from a deleted working directory
description: Replay prepare on a remote slot while the operator tmux server retains a deleted cwd. Set FARMSLOT_GATEWAY and FARMSLOT_CWD_PROOF_RUN_ID. Verifies the completed run through the live gateway and its actual fixture-copy log. Separate shell regressions exercise deleted inherited cwd and reject a missing target before hooks run.

live-prepare.intent: Replayed preparation copies fixtures into the current run directory.

directory-regressions.intent: Preparation handles deleted and missing directories without using stale paths.

replay-recovery.intent: Preparation retries preserve existing work and reject a lost established branch.
